To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>

Subject: Console walkthrough + sandbox access for onboarding

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the FinLine product team is keen to move forward with a short onboarding: a console walkthrough for our platform engineers plus a hands-on sandbox session so they can run a few API calls.

Can we schedule a 90-minute slot in the next two weeks? Preferably mornings (PST). Tentative attendees: myself, Sam Park (infra lead), and two backend engineers.

Two asks before the session:
- Sandbox credentials with ephemeral keys for the team (read/write to a dev tenant)
- A one-page agenda so we can align stakeholders

Happy to share time windows — can your team do next Wed/Thu morning?

Best,
Elaine Torres
VP, Engineering Ops
FinLine

FinLine

We can do a 90-minute session; proposing two slots next week (all PST):
- Wednesday 2027-08-25 09:30–11:00
- Thursday 2027-08-26 10:00–11:30

- 30m console deep-dive (routes, RBAC, per-route metrics)

Marissa (copied) will lead the hands-on portion. Marissa — can you confirm you’re available for either slot, and I’ll lock the invite? Also, we’ll provision temporary dev keys ahead of time; Sam, can you confirm the engineer emails so we can scope access?
